sessions.title: Visuals and effects: look and frame rate with music
preparation: Install the signed Debug build from Xcode or `xcodebuild -allowProvisioningUpdates`
Unlock, Auto-Lock Never, Do Not Disturb on, brightness fixed
Import the reference track and a few photos for In-App Playback and the Photo visual
Show the performance overlay (Settings)
record: Frame rate shown by the overlay per check
Pass/fail by eye with a one-line note
Screenshots only as illustration (never evidence of performance)

sessions.title: Shows, presets, scenes and everyday controls
preparation: A show with 4-5 cues and a few scenes
Music playing through In-App Playback
record: Pass/fail per step with a note
Times where the step names a limit

sessions.title: Debug fault injection and crash recovery
sessions.install: same Debug install (DEBUG launch arguments through Xcode's scheme editor or `devicectl ... process launch -- <args>`)
preparation: Xcode open with the device attached
The launch arguments each step names
record: Pass/fail, the event log lines the step names
Crash reports produced on purpose

sessions.title: Accessibility: VoiceOver, large text, Reduce Motion, filters, haptics and hand use
preparation: Accessibility Shortcut set to VoiceOver
Text size AX5 ready in Settings › Accessibility › Display & Text Size
Reduce Motion, Increase Contrast and Color Filters reachable
record: What VoiceOver reads for each control
Pass/fail per step

sessions.title: Audio routes, headphones, calls and interruptions
preparation: Wired headphones (USB-C or adapter) and Bluetooth headphones (AirPods)
A second phone to call D1 and a FaceTime contact for D2/D3
An alarm set 2 minutes ahead
Imported MP3/M4A tracks
record: Pass/fail per route change and interruption
Whether audio or visuals glitched

sessions.title: Camera and motion sensors
preparation: Good light and a coloured light source
A face and hands in frame
Camera permission not yet granted for the first step (reset with Settings › General › Transfer or Reset › Reset Location & Privacy only if needed)
record: Pass/fail per step
Frame rate and thermal state where asked

sessions.title: Photos and Files pickers, iCloud, sharing, import and export
preparation: Photos with HEIC, ProRAW, panorama, animated GIF, HDR and transparent PNG items
Files: On My iPhone/iPad and iCloud Drive with a not-yet-downloaded file
A DRM-protected purchase and DRM-free MP3/AAC/M4A/WAV files
A second device for AirDrop
record: Pass/fail per pick, import and share
Messages shown on refusals

sessions.title: Recording
preparation: At least 5 GB free (and, for the low-storage step, a nearly full device)
Music playing
record: File size, duration, frame rate and dropped frames
Whether the file plays in Files

sessions.title: Network: Wi-Fi controllers, two devices, Airplane Mode, privacy report
sessions.install: fresh install of the Debug build at the start (UIX-001 needs it)
preparation: A Mac or second device on the same Wi-Fi with an OSC sender/receiver
Two of D1-D3 on one Wi-Fi
App Privacy Report on (Settings › Privacy & Security)
USB cable connected so devicectl still reaches the device in Airplane Mode
record: Pass/fail per step
App Privacy Report entries

sessions.title: MIDI hardware
preparation: A class-compliant USB MIDI controller with faders, knobs, pads (14-bit and motorised if available)
A USB-C hub
A MIDI clock source at 120 and 174 BPM
record: Pass/fail per mapping

sessions.title: External display, AirPlay and projector
preparation: USB-C to HDMI adapter and an HDMI display (4K if available)
An Apple TV on the same network
A projector (and a curved surface for grid warp)
A hardware keyboard for D2
record: Pass/fail per step
External frame rate from the overlay
Display resolution and refresh

sessions.title: iPad multitasking: Stage Manager, Split View, windows
sessions.install: same install on D2 and D3
preparation: Stage Manager on
A second app for Split View
record: Pass/fail per step

sessions.title: Measurements attached to Xcode and Instruments
sessions.install: Release build run from Xcode (Profile) with the device attached
preparation: Instruments templates: Allocations, Metal System Trace, Energy Log, os_signpost
Xcode's memory gauge and Simulate Memory Warning
A 240 fps camera for the latency steps
record: Trace files (kept outside git; note their SHA-256)
Numbers into docs/test-reports/performance.md

tasks.text: T113 [US1] {A}{device} Device checks no other task requires (owner review 2026-11-08, ADR-0001 ruling 11), run in the T040 and T041 sessions on D1 and D2 and recorded in `docs/platform-research/screencapturekit-ios.md` ("Open until device testing"): what `present()` offers (item 12); `isAvailable` (14); whether a system capture indicator appears (quickstart A.2 tester note; if none, the owner decides on an in-app indicator, ruling 10); the microphone stays out (13); `excludesCurrentProcessAudio` with the approved test-tone build (8); an audio-only stream with the approved build without the `.screen` output (2); the minimum video size (3; if 64 × 64 is refused, a mid size, then the native size); picker callbacks and Stop cancelling a waiting start (10); FairPlay audio (11); a Control Center re-pick and a stop of sharing from system UI during capture, with callbacks, stop code and whether audio continues, in the T041 session (9, quickstart A.5); and, if audio is silent with `present()`, one diagnostic run with `present(using: .display)` before T056 (ruling 6). Temporary builds are diagnostic only and never compatibility evidence — AC: each item has a recorded result with its export or tester note on D1 and D2; required before Gate 1 — ⛔ not required (owner ruling 2026-11-09, ADR-0001 ruling 18): the extra device checks stay unanswered

T049 [US2] {A}{device} Run US2 acceptance scenarios 1–7 on every FR-032 device; record them in `docs/test-reports/compatibility-report.md` — AC: all 7 scenarios pass on every device, and SC-004 (Active audio within 2 s) holds — ⛔ not required (owner ruling 2026-11-09, ADR-0001 ruling 18): Microphone and In-App Playback stay unverified on devices beyond the T040 runs

T050 [US2] {A}{device} Phase A real-time check (Constitution VII): run an allocation trace for 60 s on each Phase A adapter callback (System/App Capture, Microphone, In-App Playback) on the reference device before any Gate 1/2 run; record the results in `docs/test-reports/performance.md` — AC: zero heap allocations and zero lock acquisitions on each audio callback thread — ⛔ not required (owner ruling 2026-11-09, ADR-0001 ruling 18): Constitution VII still applies; the allocation-free audio callbacks are verified by design, code review and unit tests only, not by a device trace

T051 [US3] {A}{device} For each FR-030 source on each applicable device, run 10 minutes in the foreground and export diagnostics into `docs/test-reports/exports/<device>/<source>/` — AC: SC-001 coverage (≥ 2 capture-capable iPhones + 1 iPad for capture sources; all devices for fallbacks) — ⛔ not required (owner ruling 2026-11-09, ADR-0001 ruling 19; Gates 1 and 2 waived): no 10-minute runs, so no source gets an FR-031 rating

T053 [US3] {A}{device} Gate 2: for each source rated "Works", run a 30-minute foreground capture (results in `docs/test-reports/compatibility-report.md`) on the reference device and record unrecovered failures, dropped audio, start-to-first-audio, CPU, and memory against the Gate 2 thresholds in spec Delivery Gating — AC: each Works source passes or is downgraded to Partial with its reason — ⛔ not required (owner ruling 2026-11-09, ADR-0001 ruling 19; Gates 1 and 2 waived): no source is rated "Works", so there is nothing to run
